strokes.caption: The piston moves down with the intake valve open, drawing fresh mixture into the cylinder.
strokes.name: Intake

strokes.caption: The piston moves up with intake and exhaust valves closed, compressing the trapped mixture.
strokes.name: Compression

strokes.caption: A spark ignites the mixture and the expanding gas drives the piston down.
strokes.name: Power

strokes.caption: The piston moves up with the exhaust valve open, pushing burnt gas out of the cylinder.
strokes.name: Exhaust
